observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G lens resting on bubble wrap with a lens hood nearby.
Photo 1 shows the same lens held by fingers, with the front element and barrel markings visible.
Photo 2 shows the lens from another angle with the lens hood placed beside it.
The text "Nikon", "AF-S NIKKOR", and "50mm 1:1.8G" is readable on the lens barrel in all three photos.

claims.evidence: Country of origin or prior use location cannot be determined from the photos.
Exterior looks clean, but internal glass, fungus, haze, and mechanical function cannot be confirmed from photos.
"50mm" is printed on the lens barrel in photo 0, photo 1, and photo 2.

risks.risk: Internal fungus, haze, or lens element separation not visible in exterior shots.
risks.proof: Photos of front and rear glass elements with a light source behind them, or a video panning through the glass.
risks.if_unproven: as poor optical condition or not working.

risks.proof: Video of the lens mounted on a Nikon camera focusing.
risks.if_unproven: as manual focus only or not working.

risks.risk: Aperture blades may be oily, sticky, or stuck.
risks.proof: Video of the aperture lever moving or the diaphragm stopping down.

risks.risk: Lens mount or electronic contacts may be damaged or worn.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens mount and gold contacts.

proof_requests: Video of the lens mounted on a Nikon camera autofocusing and aperture stopping down.
Photos of front and rear glass elements with light shining through them.
Close-up of the lens mount and electronic contacts.
response.reason: The lens is clearly identifiable as a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G from the markings in the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case pending proof of function.
